results.text:
# Behnke Inc.

Behnke Inc. is a Transportation/Trucking/Railroad company. Behnke Inc. is a Midwest trucking business that has been providing total freight management services for over 85 years. They are one of the largest transportation firms in the batt. Behnke Inc. employs 34 people (+9.7% YoY, +3 people), founded in 1930. Headquartered in Battle Creek, Michigan, United States, with an office in Springfield.

## About

.Behnke, Inc. is a short-to-medium haul truckload carrier. The company operates out of one terminal and the company headquarters is located in Battle Creek, MI. The company transports freight for shippers and generates revenue either per mile or on a rate per truckload shipment. The company was founded by Carl H. Behnke in 1930 when he purchased the authority from Lafler Trucking. The motor carrier number of 052473 is still being used today and the company is now managed by several of Carl H. Behnke’s grandchildren.

One of the largest transportation firms in the Battle Creek/Kalamazoo, MI community, Behnke operates close to 45 tractors and over 250 dry van trailers. The company’s operations department is responsible for maintaining the control between the customer’s needs and the ability of Behnke to meet those needs. 

At Behnke, Inc., we recognize that our most important assets are our drivers. We seek to hire professional men and women who will conscientiously fulfill the needs of our customers. In turn, we offer competitive pay and benefits which provide security for our employees. Our goal is to make your employment as “worker friendly” as possible. Behnke, Inc. Is an equal opportunity employer and encourages everyone who meets the legal standards for semi-truck drivers to apply for employment with us.
